title: Action-Context Source Masking for Frozen Joint WAMs
title_zh: <TODO[title_zh]: Chinese translation; keep proper nouns and method acronyms in English>
hook: 候选检验一个对控制有实际后果的区分：同样缩短 action-query 的 observation key set 时，首步 attention mass 不如经 output projection 的 source-group action contribution 能预测下游动作价值。若按该贡献选出的 mask 在相同保留边成本下优于 group-permuted control、降低真实端到端推理时延且通过原任务 success gate，才支持它是可省的 action-conditioning 计算；任一条件失败即停止。
abstract_draft: Frozen joint World Action Models (WAMs) repeatedly update action chunks while conditioning on observations and retained future tokens, so sparse future prediction does not establish which observation reads each action update needs. Phase 1 identifies this unresolved boundary: Sparse-WAM preserves all observation/action tokens while recomputing actions, and Efficient-WAM's inference-only asymmetric schedule caches video keys and values while continuing action updates; neither establishes action-context sensitivity or its share of end-to-end cost. This proposal tests Action-Context Source Masking (ACSM), which freezes the checkpoint and native solver, scores each observation-source group at the first action evaluation using output-projected contribution, and reuses an epsilon-selected key/value mask for later action updates through a kernel that skips omitted query-key/value edges. On paired episodes, it compares dense inference, ACSM, an equal-edge source-group permutation, and attention-mass, ToPi/VATP, and CAPA-style scoring controls, with epsilon chosen on separate held-out selection episodes. The hypothesis is supported only if ACSM outperforms the matched-cost score controls on task success, the kernel truly skips computation, full latency improves within the original latency gate, and task success passes its frozen gate; otherwise the candidate stops. Any positive result is limited to each tested frozen checkpoint and benchmark and remains unvalidated until those evaluations run.

motivation.problem_framing:
Across frozen joint World Action Models (WAMs), iterative inference updates future visual latents and action chunks through coupled transformer paths. The Phase 1 bottleneck is specific to this model class: even after future-side tokens or video updates are reduced, each active native action solver update may still read the full observation and retained context. Existing evidence does not establish either how much action quality depends on those observation-source interactions or what share of full inference cost they consume, so token retention and total latency cannot answer whether action conditioning is a useful target.

Sparse-WAM is the anchor instance: it selects future tokens and reuses omitted-region predictions while retaining all observation/action tokens and recomputing action predictions. Efficient-WAM separately demonstrates an inference-only asymmetric video schedule and video K/V reuse while action updates continue. These works motivate a bounded test of the still-dense action-query-to-observation path. ACSM leaves video-query paths, action-future interactions, the native solver schedule, and frozen weights intact; it tests source-group observation edges only and does not infer that fixed observation latents imply fixed hidden states or K/V.
motivation.why_now: Recent WAM work makes the residual question concrete: Sparse-WAM (2026-09) reduces future-side computation, WAMachine (2026-09) studies state and residual reuse, and Efficient-WAM (2026-06) separates video and action schedules, yet the Phase 0 summaries leave action-query-to-observation sensitivity and cost unmeasured. This creates a bounded inference-time question that can be addressed without new training by profiling that path and comparing matched-edge masks on frozen models; it does not establish that every required checkpoint, source-provenance interface, or compact kernel is currently available, so those remain start conditions.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Sparse-WAM uses action-guided selection of future visual tokens and reuses selected or omitted-region predictions across denoising steps while recomputing action predictions.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It retains all observation/action tokens and does not test whether action queries can drop observation-source edges while preserving task success and reducing full-path latency.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its intervention targets future tokens, leaving the action-query-to-observation edge set and its task-cost contribution unmeasured.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: WAMachine combines trajectory remapping, execution-period observation rebinding, and probe-gated intermediate residual reuse.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It does not isolate the contribution of current observation-source edges read by each native action update.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its mechanism reuses or rebinds intermediate state, rather than ranking and deleting action-query-to-observation edges.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Efficient-WAM uses an inference-only asymmetric schedule with fewer video updates and cached video K/V while continuing action updates.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It does not establish the task sensitivity or full-path cost share of observation conditioning in those continuing action updates.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its compute allocation distinguishes video from action updates, not observation-source edges within the action path.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: C3ache reuses action-expert denoising residuals across inference chunks using cache-step and refresh choices.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It does not test which current observation groups a joint FastWAM-Joint action update needs.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its operator is cross-chunk residual reuse, not within-chunk action-query-to-observation context masking.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: FBFM injects newly observed state constraints and committed action overlap into active flow updates through Jacobian/pseudoinverse feedback.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It does not measure the action-query observation-context cost share or remove source-specific conditioning edges.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its intervention corrects the vector field using feedback rather than changing the current action query's observation key set.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: GlanceWAM overlaps sparse future imagination with execution through asynchronous lookahead and staleness-robust training.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It does not isolate or sparsify the observation sources read by native action updates in a frozen joint WAM.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its mechanism changes execution timing and is co-trained for staleness, rather than masking action-conditioning edges at frozen inference.

motivation.what_changes_when_gap_closes: A positive result would identify, for each tested frozen checkpoint, whether observation-source edges in the action branch can be reduced under the original success gate and whether that path has enough measured headroom to improve full inference latency. This would give Sparse-WAM- and Efficient-WAM-style systems a WAM-specific action-conditioning test and a same-edge-budget comparison against prior scoring recipes; a negative result would bound the tested opportunity rather than establish a general impossibility.

core_claim: The proposal tests whether first-update output-projected observation-source contributions can select same-cost masks that preserve the frozen task-success gate and improve full inference latency in each tested joint WAM, with WAM-specific score advantage claimed only if paired outcomes beat all matched-cost scoring controls.

key_equations.description: For each layer and observation-source group, r_lg sums the norm of its action-query attention contribution after the native output projection.
key_equations.description_zh: 对每层和 observation-source group，将该组经 native output projection 后对 action queries 的 attention contribution 取范数并求和，得到 r_lg。

key_equations.description: rho_lg normalizes each group contribution within its layer; if the denominator is zero, the rule retains every group.
key_equations.description_zh: ρ_lg 在层内按所有 observation groups 的总贡献归一化；分母为零时按规则保留全部 groups。

key_equations.description: The g_i are ordered by descending r_lg with native source order breaking ties; S_l is the shortest prefix meeting the cumulative-share target, with epsilon selected in [0,1).
key_equations.description_zh: g_i 按 r_lg 降序排列，并以 native source order 稳定打破并列；S_l 取累计贡献达到目标的最短前缀，ε 的可选范围为 [0,1)。

key_equations.description: phi_obs is the measured full-inference time share of action-query-to-observation QK/AV; this ideal Amdahl upper bound excludes scoring, packing, kernel, and other model-path costs.
key_equations.description_zh: φ_obs 是 action-query-to-observation QK/AV 在完整推理中的实测时间占比；该理想 Amdahl 上界尚未扣入评分、压紧、kernel 和其他模型路径的代价。

key_equations.description: B_l is the retained action-query-to-observation edge budget used to match ranked masks and scoring controls.
key_equations.description_zh: B_l 表示保留的 action-query-to-observation edge 数，用于匹配排名 mask 与各评分对照。

method_flow.high_level_pipeline: Freeze the native checkpoint, solver, task configuration, and backend separately for FastWAM-Joint/LIBERO and Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID/RoboLab. Profile the complete inference path and stop early if action-query-to-observation QK/AV has insufficient Amdahl headroom. On a dense first action evaluation, group observation tokens by existing provenance and compute output-projected contribution scores; choose epsilon on held-out selection episodes under the original task-success gate and full-path latency. Run later action updates with the resulting compact key/value sets, then compare paired evaluation episodes against dense inference, equal-edge controls, and the same-cost score baselines.

steps.title: Freeze each baseline
steps.what_changes: Lock each checkpoint, native solver schedule, task configuration, and backend. Keep FastWAM-Joint/LIBERO and Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID/RoboLab as separate primary pairings; record that the FastWAM-Joint matching checkpoint is unconfirmed, and treat Motus/RoboTwin 2.0 only as a conditional simulation fallback.
steps.why_this_step: The estimate is defined per frozen checkpoint and native evaluation path, so changing weights, schedule, task, or backend would change the comparison.
steps.input: The candidate's named frozen checkpoints, native solver schedules, task configurations, and backend paths.
steps.output: A fixed per-backbone inference protocol and an explicit checkpoint-availability condition.

steps.title: Measure action-path headroom
steps.what_changes: Profile the native paths in FastWAM's fastwam_joint.py/fastwam.py/mot.py and Cosmos' omni_mot_model.py plus the RoboLab policy-server entry point. Separate action-query-to-observation QK/AV, other attention, QKV, FFN, and mask/packing cost; compute phi_obs and its Amdahl upper bound, and stop if measured savings cannot meet the original latency gate.
steps.why_this_step: The action sequence is not enough to infer cost share; this measurement tests whether the proposed edge deletion can affect complete inference latency at all.
steps.input: Frozen baseline paths, path-level timing/FLOP profiles, and the pre-existing latency gate.
steps.output: phi_obs, the Amdahl headroom estimate, and a continue-or-stop decision.

steps.title: Score source groups
steps.what_changes: Use only the token packer's existing camera/view or other source provenance; if it does not expose provenance, stop rather than infer groups. On each chunk's dense first native action evaluation k_ref, read native attention alpha, values V, and output-projection head slices W_O, then compute r_lg and rho_lg; retain all groups if the normalization denominator is zero.
steps.why_this_step: The score measures the candidate's proposed output-projected source-group contribution while keeping token values, weights, image, instruction, future/action queries, and training objective fixed.
steps.input: The dense k_ref forward, native attention/value/projection outputs, and provenance-backed observation groups.
steps.output: A per-layer source-group contribution table for selecting masks.

steps.title: Select and freeze the mask
steps.what_changes: On held-out selection episodes D_select, sort groups by descending r_lg with native source order breaking ties, and choose epsilon in [0,1) so S_l(epsilon) is the shortest prefix whose cumulative rho_lg reaches 1-epsilon. Subject to the original frozen task-success gate, select the epsilon with the lowest measured full-path latency; if no pre-existing gate applies, report the success-latency curve without declaring a pass.
steps.why_this_step: A declared task gate constrains the retained context; separating D_select from later paired evaluation avoids choosing epsilon from the outcomes used to judge the candidate.
steps.input: The S3 score table, D_select episodes, original success gate, and full-path latency measurements.
steps.output: A selected epsilon and fixed per-layer S_l mask/key-value indices for paired evaluation.

steps.title: Skip omitted observation edges
steps.what_changes: For later native action solver evaluations in the chunk, send action queries and retained observation keys/values to a true variable-length or block-sparse kernel and verify omitted QK/AV is not executed. Recompute softmax over retained keys, feed the resulting attention output through the original residual/transformer blocks, and let the changed action hidden state/velocity update the original flow state; leave video-query paths, future/action interactions, FFN, and solver schedule native.
steps.why_this_step: This implements the proposed graph change in the action branch and distinguishes real edge skipping from a dense mask; the recomputed output may change the action trajectory, with no fidelity or control-sensitivity guarantee.
steps.input: The fixed S_l mask, retained observation keys/values, native action queries, and solver state.
steps.output: A sparse attention result and resulting native flow update, plus evidence that omitted QK/AV edges were skipped.

steps.title: Run matched falsification comparisons
steps.what_changes: On paired evaluation episodes D_eval not used to select epsilon, compare dense, rho_lg-ranked, and same-retained-edge-cost source-group-permutation masks, alongside native attention-mass, ToPi/VATP value-norm, and CAPA output-projected score controls. Use the same frozen checkpoint, k_ref dense forward, exact retained edge budget, and compact kernel; record task success, per-path FLOPs, full latency including scoring/packing/kernel launch, action-chunk deviation, and first action divergence, then apply the original frozen gates. Require a legally matched-cost source-group permutation; if existing provenance groups do not permit one, report that control as unavailable rather than substitute an unequal-cost arm.
steps.why_this_step: The permutation tests whether source assignment matters at fixed cost, while the prior-score arms test whether rho_lg adds WAM-specific task-action value beyond known contribution-ranking recipes; profiling and task outcomes remain separate evidence.
steps.input: Frozen paired D_eval rollouts, selected masks, same-cost scoring controls, path profiles, and original task-success/latency gates.
steps.output: Per-backbone paired quality/cost/divergence results and a stop/retain decision; score advantage is supported only if rho_lg beats every matched-cost score arm under the original gates.

steps.title: Keep robot evaluation conditional
steps.what_changes: Discuss a physical-robot phase only after simulation passes the frozen gate and a matching AgileX Cobot Magic policy/checkpoint, demonstrations/data, source implementation, and same-type hardware are confirmed. Account for any baseline post-training separately; the mask itself remains training-free and does not update weights.
steps.why_this_step: The stated physical prerequisites are unconfirmed, so simulation or recorded evidence cannot stand in for a closed-loop robot result.
steps.input: Simulation results against the frozen gate and confirmed policy/data/source/hardware prerequisites.
steps.output: A conditional robot evaluation route and a claim boundary that does not imply a completed robot experiment.

method_flow.design_reasoning_echo: The design changes the within-chunk action-conditioning graph rather than reusing observation K/V or action residuals across solver states, since fixed input latents do not establish invariant hidden states and adjacent work already occupies cache/reuse routes. It ranks source groups using output-projected action contribution instead of attention mass alone, but ToPi's cumulative contribution selection and CAPA's output-projected scoring mean neither recipe nor projection alone establishes novelty; the revised falsification therefore compares native attention mass, ToPi/VATP value-norm, and CAPA-style scores at the same retained edge budget. The first-update rho_lg is only a model-internal proxy: its ranking may not persist across later solver states, and low-scored groups may hold control-critical contact or occlusion cues. Recomputing softmax after deleting edges may change the action output, but no numeric fidelity or task guarantee follows. The trace also found value-dependent behavior, including assignments where removing a group leaves the numerical output unchanged; this is a parameter-dependent limitation, not a universal failure. Unequal source-group sizes can prevent a distinct equal-cost whole-group permutation, so that control requires a legal grouping under existing provenance and must not be replaced by an unequal-cost comparison. Finally, profiling and real compact-kernel latency are prerequisites: score/packing overhead, other model paths, and limited action-query headroom can erase any theoretical edge savings.

falsification_prediction: 先在可用的 frozen FastWAM-Joint/LIBERO 与 Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID/RoboLab 路径做 action-query→observation QK/AV 分项 profile，再在匹配 episodes 上比较 dense、rho-ranked mask、保留边成本相同的 source-group permutation；两种 baseline 分开报告，FastWAM-Joint 权重缺失时不能以 Motus 冒名替代。若完整省略路径的 Amdahl 上限或 compact-kernel 实测 savings 扣掉评分/packing 后无法改善完整 inference latency，或未超过原有 latency gate，立即终止；即使能省算也只有 task success 满足原冻结 gate 才保留。Load-bearing variable 是 rho_lg；置换 rho 对 source groups 的分配但固定保留边成本，预测 downstream LIBERO/RoboLab task success 低于 contribution-ranked mask，若无差别则机制排序不成立。真机闭环需等待 AgileX Cobot Magic 的 matching policy/data/source/hardware 可用，仿真结果不充当该证据。 各评分对照在每个相同 frozen WAM/checkpoint、matched episodes 与 k_ref 的 dense forward 上计算：native attention mass 为 m^l_j=∑_{q∈Q_l,h∈H_l}α^l_h(q,j)，ToPi/VATP value-norm 分别为 v^{l,2}_j=∑_{q,h}α^l_h(q,j)‖V^l_h(j)‖_2 与 v^{l,1}_j=∑_{q,h}α^l_h(q,j)‖V^l_h(j)‖_1，CAPA per-token output-projected contribution 为 c^l_j=∑_{q∈Q_l}‖∑_{h∈H_l}W^l_{O,h}(α^l_h(q,j)V^l_h(j))‖_2（H_l 是 layer l 的 native attention heads）；各 token score 在 G_o 内求和形成 group score，按分数降序并以 native source order 稳定打破并列，完整保留 ranked groups 后由边界 group 中按同一 token score 排序的 token 前缀补足，恰好匹配 B_l=|Q_l||H_l|∑_{g∈S_l(ε)}|g| 个 action-query→observation QK/AV edges，token 并列按 native token order；每个 mask 固定用于同 chunk 后续 native action updates 并走同一 compact kernel；dense、rho_lg-ranked 与 permutation arms、task-success metric、原冻结 success/latency gates 与原 claim 均保持不变；每臂完整 latency 计入对应 scoring、packing、kernel launch 与其余模型路径，只有 rho_lg 在原 gate 下的 paired task-success effect 优于所有同边预算评分臂，才支持 WAM-specific score advantage。
compute_budget: 本 generation 未运行实验：GPU-days 为 0，external API 为 $0。后续 path profile 与 paired benchmark 的 GPU-days 暂不估算，须先确认 FastWAM-Joint checkpoint、两套 kernel 支持和 Amdahl headroom，再由获批 compute allocation 估算；没有假定 GPU-day 或付费 API 预算。AgileX 路线若需 baseline 原有 task post-training，其成本与本 training-free mask 方法分开核算。
what_step_was_missed: Sparse-WAM 若要已经包含此候选，需要构造由 action-query output-projected contribution 定义的 observation-source edge mask，在 action stream 中压紧 key/value 并证明 kernel 真实减少 action-query QK/AV 成本，同时用等成本 group-permutation 检验下游 task success；其现有方法是选择 future tokens，且保留全部 observation tokens。

data.rationale: The matching FastWAM-Joint checkpoint is unconfirmed, while the recorded public Cosmos3-Edge/DROID/RoboLab path is a separate baseline and Motus/RoboTwin 2.0 is only a conditional simulation fallback, not an equivalent substitute.

theoretical.rationale: The proposal defines a ranking and an empirical falsification test but claims no theorem or proof-based guarantee.

engineering.rationale: The binding implementation cost is integrating provenance-aware grouping and a compact variable-length or block-sparse kernel that truly skips QK/AV in each frozen backend, with both support paths unconfirmed.

falsification.rationale: The paired arms, outcomes, controls, frozen gates, and stop rules are concrete, but matching checkpoint, provenance access, legal equal-cost permutation, and compact-kernel support remain prerequisites.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: Sparse-WAM 用 action-to-future attention 选择 future tokens 并跨步复用省略区域预测、同时保留 observation/action tokens；本候选只改 action queries 到 observation-source groups 的边，并要求 output-projected contribution 的同成本 permutation control 与真实 sparse QK/AV 省算。
WAMachine 跨 replans remap trajectory、执行期 rebinding 并 probe 后复用中间层 residual；本候选不搬运旧状态，而在当前 native action update 中改 observation conditioning 图。
Efficient-WAM 的 inference-only asymmetric schedule 停止较早 video updates 并缓存 video K/V；本候选保留原两路 solver schedule，只尝试减少 action-query 读取 observation sources 的计算。
FBFM 以到达的真实 state 和已提交 action overlap 经 Jacobian/pseudoinverse 修正 active flow；本候选不校正 vector field 或增加反馈，而尝试跳过当前 action attention 的观测源边。
C3ache 跨 inference chunks 复用同 denoising step 的 action-expert residual；本候选不缓存 residual 或依赖跨 chunk 相似性，只在单 chunk 内压紧 action-to-observation attention。
DriveCache 用动作/场景运动信号为 diffusion backbone output 安排复用与 refresh；本候选不作 cache schedule、风险阈值或失效判断，而改变当前 action query 实际读取的 observation key set。
GlanceWAM 用 co-trained dual-timescale architecture 异步生成 lookahead latent；本候选不新增 action head、训练目标或异步执行路径，仍运行同一冻结 joint predictor。

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Paper-pointed threat: arxiv:2602.01609v1 (n/a). ToPi（supplemental_primary，§4.2–4.3；https://arxiv.org/html/2602.01609v1）在冻结 diffusion transformer 上按 target-to-context 的 attention/value contribution 排序，保留累计贡献达到 τ 的最小 context 子集，在 anchor denoising steps 重评分并在其间复用、压紧该子集；这已覆盖本候选“读出贡献分数→累计阈值选 context→跨 solver steps 复用”的通用 recipe。ToPi 的对象是图像编辑中的 target latents 与 reference tokens，并未检验 WAM action-query→observation-source edges、机器人 task success 或这一 action 路径的完整时延，故它不是同一 WAM 机制的 exact overlap。CAPA（supplemental_primary，§4.1 Eq.(2)；https://arxiv.org/html/2602.00247v1）另已使用经 W_O 投影、取 residual contribution norm 的视觉 token 分数，因此投影本身也不能支撑新颖性；当前候选仍可主张 WAM-specific 边选择，但必须在相同保留边数和任务结果下显示其分数优于这些先前分数。
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: Phase 3.2's verdict_rationale says the cumulative selection recipe and output projection are prior art but finds no exact WAM overlap, so the candidate does not claim novelty from those ingredients alone. Its revised falsification_prediction adds same-checkpoint, same-k_ref, same-edge-budget controls for native attention mass, ToPi/VATP value-norm, and CAPA-style projected scores using the same compact kernel. A WAM-specific score advantage remains conditional on paired task outcomes beating those controls while passing the original gates; no such result has been measured.
